name: Archive Daily Notes

parameters.command: pct exec 105 -- bash -c 'for vault in /mnt/nas/Obsidian/Personal /mnt/nas/Obsidian/Work; do find "$vault/Daily" -maxdepth 1 -name "*.md" -mtime +7 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do ym=$(basename "$f" | cut -c1-7); mkdir -p "$vault/Archive/Daily/$ym"; mv "$f" "$vault/Archive/Daily/$ym/"; done; done'

description: Archives daily notes older than 7 days from Personal and Work Obsidian vaults into Archive/Daily/YYYY-MM/ folders, running daily at 06:05 via SSH to Proxmox.
